name: campaign-8-4-r01-focused-plant-timer

movement.instructions: Apply the first matching rule: (1) enemy_dy < 0 AND enemy_dx <= 64: dodge_left. (2) grounded is true AND lowest_floor_drop_px == 0: run_right. (3) retreating is true AND drop_px < 32 AND lowest_floor_drop_px > 0: brake_left. (4) blocked is true AND wall_height > headroom: brake_left. Otherwise run_right. Null means absent; a comparison to null does not match.

criteria.dodge_left: Step left to avoid a nearby enemy falling from above.

enemy.instructions: Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

enemy_low.instructions: Choose C if distance_px <= 40 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

wall.instructions: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and (headroom_px is null OR height_px <= headroom_px). Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Do not jump at this wall.

pit.instructions: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and floor_gaps is not empty. Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Not time to jump; far away or a safe drop.
criteria.C: Jump over the nearby floor gap.

air.instructions: Which direction is Mario moving vertically?

instructions: Is Mario falling? Answer using the motion field only.

criteria.right_run_jump: No, motion is grounded or rising or airborne.

memory_notes.instructions: Walk down the initial stairs before jumping. Jump right if motion is rising, or if grounded and feet_y >=160. Otherwise walk right without run or jump.

criteria.right_run_jump: Rising, OR grounded with feet_y >=160: jump right.
criteria.right: Otherwise: walk right with no run or jump.

memory_notes.instructions: Wait for the pipe plant to retract. If note_elapsed_frames.first-pipe-wait < 90, wait. Otherwise jump right when grounded or rising; move right without jump when falling.

criteria.wait: Timer below 90: wait with buttons released.
criteria.right_run_jump: Timer at least 90 and grounded or rising: jump right.
criteria.right_run: Timer at least 90 and falling: move right with jump released.

memory_notes.instructions: Wait for the pipe plant to retract. If note_elapsed_frames.third-pipe-wait < 90, wait. Otherwise jump right when grounded or rising; move right without jump when falling.

criteria.wait: Timer below 90: wait with buttons released.
criteria.right_run_jump: Timer at least 90 and grounded or rising: jump right.
criteria.right_run: Timer at least 90 and falling: move right with jump released.

memory_notes.instructions: This note was first encountered on the initial passage. If note_elapsed_frames.pipe-after-coordinate-loop < 400, jump right when grounded or rising, otherwise run right. After 400 frames, this is the scroll-loop passage: align over elevated pipe at x280. Walk right if x<276, walk left if x>284; otherwise hold down until entering the pipe.

criteria.right_run_jump: Note timer below400 and grounded or rising: jump right.
criteria.right_run: Note timer below400 and falling: run right.
criteria.right: Note timer at least400 and x<276: walk right.
criteria.left: Note timer at least400 and x>284: walk left.
criteria.down: Note timer at least400 and276<=x<=284: hold down.

instruction_router.instructions: Read ONLY note_elapsed_frames.pipe-after-coordinate-loop. Which instruction set applies?

cross.description: The timer is less than 400: first passage, cross this area.
cross.instructions: Is Mario falling? Use only the motion field.

criteria.right_run_jump: No: grounded or rising or airborne.

enter.description: The timer is at least 400: return passage, enter the pipe.
enter.instructions: Align over the pipe. Walk right if x<276, left if x>284, otherwise press down.

memory_notes.instructions: First read the number at note_elapsed_frames.second-section-plant. If it is less than 90, select wait regardless of motion. Only when it is 90 or greater: select right_run_jump if grounded is true or motion is rising; otherwise select right_run.

criteria.right_run_jump: Timer is 90 or greater AND (grounded is true OR motion is rising).
criteria.right_run: Timer is 90 or greater AND motion is falling.

memory_notes.instructions: Use the hidden block. During note_elapsed_frames.hidden < 100, align at x2390 and jump straight up: right when x<2388, left when x>2392, jump otherwise. During 100 <= note_elapsed_frames.hidden < 140, move left. After 140, jump right if grounded or rising, otherwise run right.

criteria.left: Timer below 100 and x above2392; OR timer from100 through139.
criteria.jump: Timer below100 and x between2388 and2392.
criteria.right_run_jump: Timer at least140 and grounded or rising.

memory_notes.instructions: Is note_elapsed_frames.recovery less than 10? Answer using only that number.
Is Mario grounded? Answer using grounded only.

criteria.left_jump: No, airborne: keep holding jump and brake left.

Is horizontal_speed at least 1? Answer using only horizontal_speed.

criteria.wait: No: waterbrake timer >= 16; release buttons and descend.

memory_notes.instructions: Swim right beneath the ceiling firebar. If jump_held is false and feet_y >176, stroke upward. Otherwise release jump and keep swimming right.
Swim along the bottom below the late firebars. If jump_held is false and feet_y >208, stroke upward. Otherwise release jump and continue right.
